title: Overflow characterizes the all-ones word
statement: Let $w$ be a finite Boolean word, and consider its fixed-width binary increment, with overflow interpreted as the empty word. If the resulting word is empty, then every entry of $w$ is true.
hypotheses_covered: The fixed-width increment of $w$, interpreted as the empty word on overflow, is empty
